title: Project vault retrieval, governed agent run, human decision, and replay
accessibility: Evidence, confidence, assumptions, cost, and human decision are semantically navigable
Citation and approval controls are keyboard and screen-reader operable
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Retrieval cannot cross project, permission, residency, retention, or rights boundaries
Agent capability and budget are server-resolved and fail closed
Output cannot mutate approved work before accountable human acceptance
persistence: Source checksums, exact evidence spans, prompt, model, policy, output, reviewer, and usage receipt persist
Supersession preserves prior knowledge and agent artifacts
concurrency: Stale source or policy revisions invalidate the run
Duplicate decisions and replay requests are idempotent
degradedDependencies: Missing source authority, model drift, provider outage, and budget exhaustion fail closed
Audit or receipt failure prevents publication
rollback: Agent proposals are versioned artifacts and never overwrite accepted work
Replay uses retained inputs without silently substituting providers or prompts
